plugins.name: emory
plugins.description: API-support triage agent — routes a case (paste/attach/Salesforce/email) EAS vs Legacy, runs five read-only config checks against live data, and returns a routable verdict + a paste-ready SR summary. Never concludes 'the API is broken' until every config check passes.
plugins.author: Eric Durrant

plugins.name: apibrain-claims
plugins.description: Claims-resolution analyst — the claims/payments/finance sibling to Emory. Classifies a claim, payment, mapping, reconciliation, sync, or SG PPS/Express/Connect case, grounds it in the claims KB (SOP/BRD/RCA), names the owning team, and drafts a customer update + paste-ready SR summary. Read-only; routes rating/classing cases to Emory.
plugins.author: Eric Durrant
